title: Context management across sessions (from canoe)
summary: New EPIC-0011 with 7 requirements (REQ-0057 to REQ-0063), 5 stories, 12 tasks and 10 evals: a project snapshot under an 8 KB budget loaded into every chat and agent session and re-supplied after compaction; one next action per task; DEC decision records counted once tested code uses them; metadata-only session and agent-run history kept 365 days then compacted monthly; graded research findings with refresh-by dates.
rationale: Adapted from the canoe harness. Product owner decisions on 2026-10-04: agents propose snapshot and next-action updates and the user accepts them (REQ-0041 unchanged); decisions are a DEC record kind exercised through trace tags and evidence; history is kept 365 days then compacted into monthly summaries. Research grading and refresh-by periods follow canoe: 60 days for fast-changing findings, 180 for slow. canoe's own gap is closed: its snapshot was only pointed to, never injected; REQ-0058 requires the full text.

data.title: Context management across sessions
data.description: Durable project state that survives chat sessions, agent runs, context compaction and long gaps: snapshot, next actions, decisions, history and research.

data.title: Project snapshot
data.statement: The system shall keep one snapshot per project in state/HOT.md with Now, Next and Watch sections and a Last reconciled date, at most 8,192 bytes, changed only by applying a proposed changeset.
data.rationale: A small, always-current summary lets every session start from the project's real state instead of chat history.

acceptance_criteria.text: state/HOT.md has the headings Now, Next and Watch in that order and a line 'Last reconciled: YYYY-MM-DD'; Next holds exactly 1 item
A changeset may carry a snapshot op with the full new content; the changeset card shows its diff, Apply writes and commits it, and 0 other paths write the file
Simulate reports an error for a snapshot over 8,192 bytes, without the 3 required headings, or with more than 1 Next item
Lint warns when Last reconciled is more than 21 days old

data.source: product owner request 2026-10-04; adapted from canoe

data.title: Snapshot in agent context
data.statement: The system shall include the project snapshot's full text in the context of every chat session and coding-agent run, and supply it again after the agent's context is compacted.
data.rationale: A pointer to the file is not enough; the agent must see the state at start and after compaction.

acceptance_criteria.text: The first turn of a chat session includes the snapshot text verbatim, marked as project state, not a pointer to the file
A coding-agent brief includes the snapshot text verbatim after the task section
When Claude Code compacts a chat or agent session, the snapshot is supplied again before the next model turn
With no snapshot file, sessions start normally and the chat panel shows 'No project snapshot' with an action to ask Claude to draft one

data.source: product owner request 2026-10-04; adapted from canoe

data.title: Next action per task
data.statement: The system shall keep exactly one next action per task, proposed when an agent run or chat session on the task ends and shown first when the next one starts.
data.rationale: One concrete cue written at stop time is the most reliable way to resume work after a gap.

acceptance_criteria.text: Tasks have a next_action field of at most 280 characters that names a file path, command or record id
When an agent run ends, a line starting 'NEXT:' in its final message becomes a pending proposal on the task, which the user accepts, edits or rejects in the task drawer
A coding-agent brief and the task drawer show the task's next_action first, with the date it was set
Starting a new chat or closing the chat panel after a changeset was applied in the session asks the chat agent once to propose updated next actions and a snapshot Next

data.source: product owner request 2026-10-04; adapted from canoe

data.title: Decision records
data.statement: The system shall store decisions as DEC-NNNN records with title, context, decision, status, linked requirements and superseded_by, created and changed only through changesets.
data.rationale: Design decisions need their own traceable records so they can be checked against code.

acceptance_criteria.text: title, context and decision are required; status is one of proposed, accepted or superseded, default proposed
requirements must reference existing requirements; status superseded requires superseded_by naming another decision, and supersession cycles are rejected
Decisions are available in search, CSV export, the record drawer and the MCP tools like other kinds, and the chat agent can only propose them

data.source: product owner request 2026-10-04; adapted from canoe

data.title: Decisions exercised by code
data.statement: The system shall mark a decision exercised when at least one code location is tagged 'reqforge: implements DEC-NNNN' and every test tagged with that id has passing evidence.
data.rationale: A decision only counts once working code relies on it; unexercised decisions are design debt.

acceptance_criteria.text: The code scan records DEC-NNNN implements and verifies tags in the same way as REQ tags
Each decision shows exercised yes or no with its tagged locations; a failing or suspect tagged test makes it no
Lint warns for every accepted decision not exercised within 14 days of acceptance
A Decisions tab lists decisions with status, exercised flag and linked requirements

data.source: product owner request 2026-10-04; adapted from canoe

data.title: Session and agent-run history
data.statement: The system shall append one metadata-only entry per chat session and agent run to an append-only history, keep entries for 365 days and then compact them into one summary per month.
data.rationale: A durable, private record of when and how work happened shows gaps and patterns without storing conversation content.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each entry has kind, id, project, user, start, end, outcome, changesets proposed and applied, and records touched; 0 prompt, message or tool-output text is stored
Entries are only appended; compaction is the only rewrite, runs at most once per day and makes 1 commit
Entries older than 365 days are replaced by monthly summaries with session count, total duration and outcome counts, and 0 entries younger than 365 days are removed

A gap of 14 days or more between sessions is recorded as deliberate when a user paused the project with a reason, otherwise as unexplained, and the next session start shows the gap and lets the user give a reason

data.source: product owner request 2026-10-04; adapted from canoe

data.title: Graded research findings
data.statement: The system shall store research findings as append-only graded entries with sources and a refresh-by date, citable from a requirement's standards.
data.rationale: Research behind requirements goes stale; grading and refresh-by dates make staleness visible instead of remembered.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each finding has an id RF-NNNN, claim, grade (VERIFIED, THIN or REFUTED), at least 1 source URL, date and perishability; refresh_by is the date plus 60 days for fast and 180 days for slow perishability
Findings are added only through changesets and never edited; a re-check appends a new finding that supersedes the old one
Lint warns for each requirement whose standards cite a finding that is REFUTED or past its refresh_by date
Claim and source text are stored with newlines and Markdown control characters removed, so 0 findings can add headings or instructions to snapshots or briefs

data.source: product owner request 2026-10-04; adapted from canoe

stories: 5 new stories under new EPIC-0011 (19 points, all server). No existing story changes scope.
code: Server: changes.rs (new snapshot and finding ops), model.rs and store.rs (decisions kind; next_action on tasks), mcp.rs tool schemas (decisions kind), codetrace.rs and verify.rs (DEC tags, exercised), lint.rs (snapshot staleness, unexercised decisions, stale findings), chat.rs, chat_prompt.md and agent.rs (snapshot injection, NEXT: capture), a new history module with compaction.
Plugin: a SessionStart hook for source=compact that re-supplies the snapshot; standards-researcher agent and elicit skill.
Web: ChangesetCard (snapshot diff), ChatPanel (empty state, New/Close prompt), RecordDrawer (next action), a Decisions tab, a gap prompt.
New tests: server/tests/context.rs, decisions.rs, history.rs, research.rs; e2e suites snapshot, next-action, decisions, history. No existing trace tags change.
evals: 10 new evals: 5 integration, 4 e2e, 1 security (findings sanitisation).
risks: The snapshot is injected into every prompt, so it is trusted input to agents. It can only change through an applied changeset, and research text is sanitised (REQ-0063 AC4), but a careless snapshot edit still steers every agent.
A new decisions kind touches schema, MCP, CSV and UI across the stack; it is the largest item (STORY-0019).
The coding agent cannot propose changesets (REQ-0052 AC3), so its next action is captured by the server from a 'NEXT:' line, which depends on the agent following its brief.
The 14-day gap threshold and the 21-day staleness warning are canoe's defaults; adjust them if they don't fit how this project is worked.
